questions.prompt: The Hunger Games just owned the weekend — a $120 million debut, and everyone's talking about it. Tonight, which scene sounds most like yours?

options.text: Already got my ticket — opening weekend waits for no one.
Going with the crew — a debut this big needs witnesses.
Letting the crowds thin first — I'll catch it when the rush fades.
Still deciding — too many showtimes, too many takes, can't pick one.

questions.prompt: Tesla's new update turns your drive into Grand Theft Auto — the road, the cars, the whole view rendered like the game. Tonight, how are you meeting a drive that looks like Vice City?

options.text: Showing everyone — look, my car thinks it's in Vice City.
Eyes on the road — the game's fun, but I'm still driving.
Too much on the screen — I can't tell the game from the road.
Turning it off — I want my drive quiet, not a game.

questions.prompt: Don Toliver just postponed his London O2 show — the night you were waiting for isn't happening. Tonight, how are you sitting with a plan that just fell apart?

options.text: Annoyed — I had the night planned around it.
Taking it in stride — the night's still mine, show or no show.
Moving on — already lining up something else for tonight.
Quietly gutted — I was looking forward to it, and nothing else sounds right.

questions.prompt: PS5 games are $15 for Black Friday — the hunt's on tonight, deals scrolling past, wishlist in hand. If someone handled the table for your deal-hunt night, what would you want on it?

options.text: Something fizzy to crack open — sparkling cider or champagne, a $15 steal deserves a toast.
A warm mug of cocoa or tea — slow sips between deals.
Snacks to pass around — the hunt's better with someone to show the finds to.
Just water, I don't need anything else tonight.

questions.prompt: Blade Runner 2099 is almost here — the reviews are in, and the rain-soaked neon world is back tomorrow. Tonight, which sound of that world is your vibe?

options.text: Rain on neon — the slow patter over the city hum.
The low synth drone — the sound of the city breathing.
The full city buzz — sirens, crowds, all of it turned up.
None of it tonight — my own quiet, the rain can wait.

questions.prompt: Thanksgiving travel is here — the bags, the lists, the 'did I forget something' feeling before Thursday. In the hour ahead, what does your evening feel like?

options.text: Packing with a list — checking it twice, no surprises.
Buzzing for the road — the trip's the best part, let's go.
Still spinning — too many lists, too many 'did I forgets'.
Not packing tonight — the bags can wait, I'm staying put.
